name: The Not So Little Chicken Sandwich (High Fat/Grease Warning)
whyItWorks: An oversized fried chicken schnitzel deep-fried in oil, topped with pickled cabbage slaw and teriyaki chili sauce on a tiny miniature brioche bun. The high grease and raw pickled cabbage can provoke intense gut spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried & Slaw Warning: Avoid during flares. If ordering in remission, peel away the thick fried coating and discard the cabbage slaw.
